messages:
leo_infra: Quick check — running private DC2 perf suite (8x A100, private image) and seeing ~25% higher token latency vs hosted for the same model. Suspect IRQ and CPU isolation differences. Can folks share the canonical kernel params / sysctl checklist for our Private images? Need steps to reproduce perf parity.

jaya: which kernel version + distro + container runtime? also exact bench command you ran?

leo_infra: ubuntu 22.04, kernel 5.15 (GKE-compatible), docker 24, nvidia-container-runtime. Bench: `./bench/run_infer.sh --model gpt-3-small --seq 512 --concurrency 8` — numbers: median token latency 21ms vs hosted 16ms. pinned threads with systemd `CPUAffinity=` and `taskset` for processes.

sam_ops: can you paste `nproc --all` and a snippet of `/proc/interrupts` from one node? also whether irqbalance service is running.

leo_infra: pasted minimal snips below:
```
$ nproc --all
96
$ head -n 6 /proc/interrupts
           CPU0       CPU1       CPU2       CPU3  ...
  16:    1234567    2345678    1200000    1300000  ...  PCI-MSI-edge eth0
  17:       3456       1234       2345       4567  ...  PCI-MSI-edge nvme0
  27:      98765      87654      76543      65432  ...  PCI-MSI-edge nvidia
```
irqbalance is active by default on the image.

nina_research: thanks. two quick ideas: (1) irqbalance can move GPU/eth interrupts off of the pinned CPUs — try `systemctl stop irqbalance` and set affinity for the NIC/GPU IRQs to non-scheduling cores, (2) ensure `nohz_full` + `isolcpus` on kernel cmdline match our hosted defaults. Also check C-states: we disable deep C-states on hosted.

sam_ops: adding concrete commands to try:
- stop irqbalance: `sudo systemctl stop irqbalance`
- pin IRQs: `for i in $(grep nvidia /proc/interrupts | cut -d: -f1); do echo 2 > /proc/irq/$i/smp_affinity_list; done` (use spare cores)
- disable C-states via `intel_idle.max_cstate=1` or vendor equivalent in kernel args

leo_infra: thanks. I'll try those. Also curious if anyone has the hosted kernel cmdline we use so I can mirror exactly.

jaya: hosted cmdline for reference: `quiet intel_pstate=disable nohz_full=2-31 isolcpus=2-31 mitigations=off intel_idle.max_cstate=1` — we also ship a tuned `tuned` profile that sets governor to performance and disables powersave for NICs.

perf-bot: smoke-run complete on node dc2-04 with irqbalance stopped: median token latency 17.8ms, p95 34ms. Artifacts: https://internal.artifacts/redwood/perf/1802004567/dc2-04-smoke.tar.gz :thumbsup:

leo_infra: nice, that's within noise of hosted. Two followups: (A) can we add automated check in our Private bootstrap that ensures irqbalance is disabled for dedicated pools? (B) add a note in the Private README about kernel cmdline and tuned profile.

sam_ops: for (A) we can add a systemd unit `private-postboot-check.service` that validates IRQ affinities and kernel cmdline and fails early (non-blocking alert). I'll open a PR and ping codeowners.

jaya: ping @sam_ops for review on infra/kernel-tuning branch when ready — want this in next Dedicated image cycle.

leo_infra: action item — I'll run full perf suite on 3 nodes with those changes and upload flamegraphs by EOD. tagging ops-bot for scheduled reboots: @ops-bot please coordinate reboot window 6-8pm PST.

ops-bot: scheduled maintenance window created for dc2 nodes 6:00pm PST — will notify on-call 30m prior.

nina_research: also grabbing a flamegraph sample request: run `perf record -F 99 -a -g -- sleep 60` inside the container then `perf script | flamegraph.pl > f.svg` — upload to artifacts and paste link here.

leo_infra: will do. Thanks all, will update thread after runs. :+1:
